mission.headline: Observe clearly. Understand deeply. Choose your own direction.
mission.summary: Waypoint Studio helps people observe what is happening, understand why it matters, and choose their own direction. It does not assign tasks, homework, streaks, or obligations.
mission.studioCycleNote: Create and Share remain part of the broader studio identity, especially central to Waypoint Scenes. They are not required behaviors in every app.
userAutonomy: A user may simply read, observe, or leave.
No required steps, progress stages, assignments, or onboarding gates.
Direction labels describe support, not commands.
Safety-critical guidance may remain clear and direct.

observe.label: Observe
observe.meaning: Help the user see what is happening — conditions, maps, forecasts, signals, photographs, personal notes, history, alerts, and measurements.

understand.label: Understand
understand.meaning: Help the user understand why it matters — research, field guides, plain-language summaries, evidence limits, and practical interpretation.

products.name: Sheds
products.observe: Terrain, seasonality, private sign notes, coverage, and relative search priority.
products.understand: Cervid biology, winter habitat, ethics, and research that explains why certain places may matter.

direction.label: Search
direction.description: Support deciding where, when, and whether to search — never requiring entry onto unsafe, closed, restricted, or private land.

products.name: Fieldry
products.observe: Encounters, locations, timing, and personal field notes.
products.understand: Ecology, taxonomy, phenology, identification context, and conservation framing.

direction.label: Record
direction.description: Support noticing and preserving observations. Logging is never required.

products.name: ForageCast
products.observe: Seasonal land conditions across foraging, orchard, garden, and stewardship contexts.
products.understand: Fungal and plant ecology, phenology, weather relationships, and safety limits.

direction.label: Explore
direction.description: Offer practical seasonal direction while preserving choice. Food-safety warnings stay direct and prominent.

products.name: Steepleaf
products.observe: Leaf, liquor, aroma, water, and preparation context.
products.understand: Tea botany, processing, terroir, water chemistry, and sensory research.

direction.label: Brew
direction.description: An invitation to understand preparation — not a prescribed ritual.

products.name: Savant Sommelier
products.observe: Region, grape, climate, and sensory notes.
products.understand: Viticulture, fermentation, terroir, sensory science, and climate context.

direction.label: Taste
direction.description: Support tasting literacy without treating preferences as objective rankings.

ctaExamples: Why climate may shape this vintage

products.name: SignalTerrain
products.observe: Spectrum context, advisories, outages, and environmental radio conditions.
products.understand: Radio science, propagation, space weather, infrastructure awareness, and defensive cyber literacy.

direction.label: Monitor
direction.description: Awareness and interpretation only — defensive, educational, lawful, and non-operational.

products.name: Outdoor Intelligence Dashboard
products.observe: Weather, air, light, trails, safety, and seasonal change.
products.understand: Weather science, hydrology, air quality, fire conditions, and outdoor safety context.

direction.label: Plan
direction.description: Inform decisions without telling users they must go outside.

products.name: Waypoint Scenes
products.observe: Light, subject, place, and photographic conditions.
products.understand: Perception, composition, camera science, ecology, and visualization ethics.

direction.label: Create
direction.description: Optional, personal, exploratory making — free from competition. Create belongs naturally here.

products.name: Photo Coach
products.observe: A photograph and what is visible in it.
products.understand: Composition, perception psychology, technique, and storytelling context.

direction.label: Refine
direction.description: Coaching suggestions — not grading-based obligations. Lower scores are not framed as failure.

products.name: Hidden Landscapes
products.observe: Ordinary scenes under alternate spectral or temporal views.
products.understand: Nonhuman vision, infrared/UV, polarization, and visualization ethics.

direction.label: Reveal
direction.description: Help uncover landscape aspects that ordinary human vision misses.

knowledgeLayer.name: Waypoint Knowledge
knowledgeLayer.role: Curated research and published-source companion — not a news feed, not a chatbot.
